notes.title: 1.02.003 - HUGE Optimization Update, Bug Fixes, and a Special Announcement 😉
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413137/c90f83ab9e2b1a4633b02a52bedf0ff3d69c1d06.png

Hey there everyone!

This patch brings a giant optimization update.  The level generation was completely reworked, yielding performance increases of ~100+ FPS in some cases!

But here's the real news:
We are officially working as a full team on The Backrooms Game FULL Edition!
We will be announcing more details and teasers really soon, but in the meantime, check out the roadmap we have on our website!

If you want to follow the development of The Backrooms Game FULL Edition even more closely, join our communities!  We hear your suggestions, comments, and general feedback on the state of the current game, and where the FULL Edition is going!

Discord
Reddit

Excited to show more updates for the FULL Edition!  

Happy noclipping 😎
-David III

The Backrooms Game 1.02.003 Update Log - 8/20/19
New Additions (2):
-Added partial controller support (Xbox360 and XboxOne controllers only).  Please note that controllers will NOT work in menus, but will ONLY work during gameplay.  Full controller support coming in the FULL Edition.
-Sprinting now compatible with Right Shift for all you left handers out there

Bug Fixes (6):	
-Fixed typo on main menu screen
-Modified dead zone of joystick axis detection in hopes of resolving undesirable movement for this with HOTAS’s connected to their system
-Fixed rare bug where the floor would fail to generate
-Fixed rare bug where the ceiling would fail to generate
-Fixed issue where stains on the ceiling would clip in and out of the ceiling as it lowers
-Fixed issue where distance would sometimes calculate incorrectly after very far distances

Optimizations (2):
-Decreased the number of overall tiles used, resulting in less light calculations and a much greater average FPS
-Heavily optimized the level generation algorithm

notes.title: 1.02.002 - Being More Common, Exits More Rare, Bug Fixes and More! 😎
notes.notes:
Hey there all!

The Being is a bit more common in this update, and will behave much more as intended (not spawning right in front of you anymore, less distorted at further distances etc.).

Exits are now a bit more rare, and will likely appear further from the start than in the previous version!

More updates and details regarding The Backrooms Game FULL Edition coming soon! 😎👉👉

Happy noclipping,
David III

The Backrooms Game 1.02.002 Update Log - 8/2/19

Changes (14):
-Being now spawns in more predictable radius around player
-Easter egg now spawns in more predictable radius around player
-Being initial spawn chance increased slightly
-Player will now need to be further from Being for It to disappear
-Increased volume of light pops
-Increased the minimum range for lights to pop overhead
-Room shake madness effect minimum duration extended
-Changed sound of room shake madness effect
-Increased fisheye madness effect initial value
-Increased fisheye madness effect gain value
-Decreased distortion shader of the Being
-Decreased the max spawn distance for the Being
-Decreased spawn rate of Exits
-Exits now appear even further from the start

Bug Fixes (3):	
-Being no longer spawns on top of player or directly next to/in front of player (Being will still spawn in front of player, just not at such a drastically close distance)
-Fixed issue where outlets would often pop into existence when a player is near them
-Fixed issue where screen would continue to shake after death during the room shake madness effect

notes.title: 1.02.001 - Being Balancing, Options Menu, Bug Fixes and More! 😎
notes.notes:
The Backrooms Game 1.02.001 Update Log - 7/29/19
New Additions (3):
-Added options menu to pause menu while playing game
-Added volume slider to options menu
-Added seizure warning

Changes (5):
-Made “Remember who you are and where you come from” text slightly yellow
-Made text on initial settings menu more readable
-Easter egg will no longer appear in a particular game once interacted with at least once
-Increased Being spawn rate by 100%
-Increased Being range to sense player by 33%

Bug Fixes (3):	
-Fixed issue where madness would still increase after pausing game
-Fixed issue where game would sometimes not unpause after being paused for a long period of time
-Fixed issue where tentacle ceiling tiles would sometimes not spawn a tentacle
